title: Everything after an unterminated `</tag` is dropped from the document
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. An end tag that is never closed with `>` makes the rest of the document disappear. This bites anyone documenting shell redirections in inline code. Input: `markdown.markdown('Run `cmd 2Run cmd 2</dev/null here.

\n

This paragraph should not disappear.

` Actual: `

Run `cmd 2

` It is not specific to code spans: `foo foo

` instead of `

foo </bar

\n

baz

`. An incomplete end tag (with or without a name, or with trailing text before any `>`) should be treated as literal text, and the content after it must be kept.
acceptance: Both reported inputs render as expected
Other incomplete end tags (e.g. `</dev`, `</ab c`, `</dev/`) in code spans or text do not swallow following content
